source.text: הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל־מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, hope his is proved a lie; ? even at [the] sight of it is he hurled down?

en.L: Look, his hope is proved a lie; \q is he not hurled down even at the sight of it?
en.B: Any hope of overpowering it is false; \q the mere sight of it lays a person low.
en.R: No one can hope to defeat it. \q Just seeing it makes people fall down in fear.

es.L: Mira, su esperanza resulta mentira; \q ¿no es derribado aun con solo verlo?
es.B: Toda esperanza de dominarlo es falsa; \q con solo verlo, uno cae por tierra.
es.R: Nadie puede esperar vencerlo. \q Con solo verlo, la gente cae de miedo.

fr.L: Voici, son espoir est démenti ; \q n’est-il pas terrassé rien qu’à sa vue ?
fr.B: Tout espoir de le maîtriser est vain ; \q sa seule vue suffit à terrasser quelqu’un.
fr.R: Personne ne peut espérer le vaincre. \q Rien qu’à le voir, on tombe de peur.

sw.L: Tazama, tumaini lake limekuwa uongo; \q je, hatupwi chini hata kwa kumwona tu?
sw.B: Tumaini lolote la kumshinda ni la uongo; \q kumwona tu kunamwangusha mtu chini.
sw.R: Hakuna anayeweza kutumaini kumshinda. \q Kumwona tu kunawafanya watu waanguke kwa hofu.

vi.L: Kìa, hy vọng của người ấy hóa ra dối trá; \q chẳng phải chỉ thấy nó thôi, người ấy đã ngã quỵ sao?
vi.B: Mọi hy vọng khuất phục nó đều là ảo tưởng; \q chỉ nhìn thấy nó thôi cũng đủ khiến người ta ngã gục.
vi.R: Không ai có thể mong thắng được nó. \q Chỉ cần thấy nó, người ta đã ngã xuống vì sợ.

ko.L: 보아라, 그의 소망은 거짓으로 드러난다. \q 그것을 보기만 해도 그가 나가떨어지지 않느냐?
ko.B: 그것을 이기려는 소망은 헛된 것이다. \q 그것을 보기만 해도 사람이 쓰러진다.
ko.R: 아무도 그것을 이길 수 없다. \q 그것을 보기만 해도 사람들은 무서워서 쓰러진다.

decisions.choice: verse numbering: Hebrew 41:1-26 is 41:9-34 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text, followed here, begins chapter 41 eight verses later than many Bibles do. So Hebrew 40:25-32 is numbered 41:1-8 there, and Hebrew 41:1-26 is numbered 41:9-34. The words are the same; only the numbers differ. Job is cited here by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: his hope: the hope of anyone who would try to capture Leviathan
decisions.reason: God is still speaking of Leviathan (40:25-32). "His" looks back to the one who would lay a hand on it (40:32): whoever hopes to master it will find the hope was a lie.

decisions.choice: a question expecting yes: even the sight of it throws a person down
alternatives: even a god is thrown down at the sight of it
decisions.reason: The question form "is he not ...?" makes a strong statement. The little word before "sight" is the preposition "at", as the text is pointed, not the word for God; so the line speaks of a human attacker who collapses before the fight begins.

decisions.choice: Any hope of overpowering it (B); No one can hope to defeat it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose hope is meant and what it is a hope for (m2), and turn the question into a plain statement (m3). Balanced says "a person", Readable "people", since anyone at all is meant.

decisions.choice: Leviathan is "nó" at every level
decisions.reason: The plain pronoun for an animal; God keeps "Ta" and "ngươi" for himself and Job.

source.text: לֹֽא־אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְפָנַ֥י יִתְיַצָּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Not [is any one so] fierce that he will rouse it; and who [is] he [who] before me will take his stand?

en.L: No one [is so] fierce that he would rouse it; \q and who [is] he [who] will take his stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?
en.B: No one is fierce enough to stir it up; \q who then can stand up to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?
en.R: No one is brave enough to wake it up. \q So who could stand up against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?

es.L: Nadie [es tan] feroz que lo despierte; \q ¿y quién [es] el que se pondrá en pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?
es.B: Nadie es tan feroz como para provocarlo; \q ¿quién, entonces, podrá plantarse frente a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?
es.R: Nadie es tan valiente como para despertarlo. \q Entonces, ¿quién podría enfrentarse a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?

fr.L: Nul [n’est assez] féroce pour le réveiller ; \q et qui [est-il, celui qui] se tiendra debout devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?
fr.B: Nul n’est assez hardi pour l’exciter ; \q qui donc pourrait {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tenir tête ?
fr.R: Personne n’est assez courageux pour le réveiller. \q Alors, qui pourrait se dresser contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?

sw.L: Hakuna [aliye] mkali hata amchochee; \q basi ni nani [yeye] atakayesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}?
sw.B: Hakuna aliye shupavu kiasi cha kumchokoza; \q basi ni nani awezaye kusimama dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}?
sw.R: Hakuna aliye jasiri kiasi cha kumwamsha. \q Basi ni nani angeweza kushindana {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}?

vi.L: Không ai [đủ] dữ dằn để khích động nó; \q vậy ai [là kẻ] sẽ đứng nổi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.B: Chẳng ai đủ gan dạ để chọc giận nó; \q vậy thì ai có thể đứng nổi trước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.R: Không ai đủ can đảm để đánh thức nó. \q Vậy ai có thể chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?

ko.L: 그것을 깨울 만큼 사나운 자는 없다. \q 그런데 누가 내 앞에 버티어 서겠느냐?
ko.B: 그것을 건드릴 만큼 대담한 자가 없는데, \q 하물며 누가 내 앞에 맞설 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 그것을 깨울 만큼 용감한 사람은 없다. \q 그러니 누가 나와 맞설 수 있겠느냐?

decisions.choice: rouse it: wake Leviathan
decisions.reason: The same verb is used in 3:8, where Job called on those "who are ready to rouse Leviathan" to curse his day. God now says that no one is bold enough to do it.

decisions.choice: an argument from the lesser to the greater: if no one dares face Leviathan, no one can stand before God
decisions.reason: Leviathan is only one of God's creatures (40:15, 19). If no human being dares to stir it up, much less can anyone take a stand against the God who made it, as Job has wanted to do in court (13:3, 18-22; 23:3-7).

decisions.choice: before me (the standard Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The standard Hebrew text reads "before me", which gives the argument of m2. Some Hebrew manuscripts read "before it", which keeps the whole verse about Leviathan: who can stand up to it? The difference is one letter. The standard text is followed.

decisions.choice: brave enough (R)
decisions.reason: The word means fierce or cruel (30:21). Here it means bold enough to face danger, and Readable says that plainly.

source.text: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם לִי־הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has come before me, and I will repay? Under all the heavens to me it [belongs].

en.L: Who has come before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, that I should repay [him]? \q Under all the heavens, it [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.
en.B: Who has first given to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, that I should pay {{gender:them|him}} back? \q Everything under the whole heaven is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.
en.R: Who has ever given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} anything that I must pay back? \q Everything under heaven belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha salido al encuentro, para que yo [le] pague? \q Debajo de todos los cielos, [todo es] {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}.
es.B: ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado primero, para que yo tenga que devolvérselo? \q Todo lo que hay bajo los cielos es {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}.
es.R: ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado algo alguna vez que yo tenga que pagarle? \q Todo lo que hay bajo el cielo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece.

fr.L: Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a devancé, pour que je [le] paie de retour ? \q Sous tous les cieux, [tout est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné le premier, pour que je doive le lui rendre ? \q Tout ce qui est sous le ciel entier {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient.
fr.R: Qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a jamais donné quelque chose que je devrais rembourser ? \q Tout ce qui est sous le ciel est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Ni nani aliyenitangulia, nami nimlipe? \q Kila kilichoko chini ya mbingu zote [ni] {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}}.
sw.B: Ni nani aliyenipa kitu kwanza, ili nimlipe? \q Vyote vilivyo chini ya mbingu ni {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}}.
sw.R: Ni nani aliyewahi kunipa kitu ambacho ni lazima nimlipe? \q Kila kitu chini ya mbingu ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Ai đã đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải trả lại [người ấy]? \q Dưới khắp các tầng trời, [mọi vật] là của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trước, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải đền lại cho người ấy? \q Mọi vật dưới khắp bầu trời đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Có ai từng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} điều gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải trả lại đâu? \q Mọi thứ dưới trời đều là của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 누가 먼저 내 앞에 나왔기에 내가 [그에게] 갚아야 하겠느냐? \q 온 하늘 아래 [있는 것은] 다 내 것이다.
ko.B: 누가 먼저 내게 주었기에 내가 갚아야 하겠느냐? \q 온 하늘 아래 있는 모든 것이 내 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 내게 무엇을 준 적이 있어서 내가 갚아야 하겠느냐? \q 하늘 아래 모든 것이 다 내 것이다.

decisions.choice: has come before me ... that I should repay: has given to God first, so that God is in debt
alternatives: has confronted me, and I will repay (punish) him
who has confronted it and come out unharmed?
decisions.reason: The verb means to come to meet someone or to go before them. Followed by "repay", it pictures someone who has done God a favor first and can now demand payment. Paul quotes the thought in this sense in Romans 11:35. Others read it as a challenge, "Who has confronted me?" With different vowels the line can also be read as being about Leviathan: "Who has confronted it and remained safe?" The standard text and the sense of debt are followed.

decisions.choice: God owes no one anything, because everything is already his
decisions.reason: Under all the heavens everything belongs to God (Psalm 50:12; Deuteronomy 10:14). Job has demanded that God answer to him as to a creditor in court; God replies that no creature can put him in its debt.

decisions.choice: first given to me (B); ever given me anything (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "coming before" God means here (m1). The person repaid is anyone at all, so Balanced uses the gender setting.

decisions.choice: no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The English needs "them / him" for the person repaid; Spanish "devolvérselo", "pagarle" already cover anyone, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: French generic pronouns take no gender span ("le lui rendre"), as the French style guide says.

source.text: לֽוֹ־אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר־גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Concerning it [written: not] I will keep silent, limbs its, and [the] matter of mighty deeds and [the] grace of frame its.

en.L: I will not keep silent about its limbs, \q or the account of its might, and the grace of its frame.
en.B: I will not keep silent about its limbs, \q its mighty strength and its fine build.
en.R: I will tell you about its body, \q about its great strength and how well it is made.

es.L: No callaré acerca de sus miembros, \q ni de la noticia de su poderío, ni de la gracia de su estructura.
es.B: No callaré acerca de sus miembros, \q de su enorme fuerza y de su bella complexión.
es.R: Te hablaré de su cuerpo, \q de su gran fuerza y de lo bien hecho que está.

fr.L: Je ne me tairai pas sur ses membres, \q ni sur le récit de sa puissance, et la grâce de sa structure.
fr.B: Je ne tairai rien de ses membres, \q de sa force puissante et de sa belle stature.
fr.R: Je vais te parler de son corps, \q de sa grande force et de la façon admirable dont il est fait.

sw.L: Sitanyamaza kuhusu viungo vyake, \q wala habari ya uweza wake, na uzuri wa umbo lake.
sw.B: Sitanyamaza kuhusu viungo vyake, \q nguvu zake kuu na umbo lake zuri.
sw.R: Nitakueleza habari za mwili wake, \q nguvu zake nyingi na jinsi alivyoumbwa vizuri.

vi.L: Ta sẽ không im lặng về các chi thể nó, \q hay về điều nói về sức mạnh nó, và vẻ duyên dáng của hình vóc nó.
vi.B: Ta sẽ không im lặng về tứ chi nó, \q về sức mạnh lớn lao và thân hình cân đối của nó.
vi.R: Ta sẽ nói cho ngươi về thân thể nó, \q về sức mạnh lớn lao của nó và nó được tạo nên khéo léo thế nào.

ko.L: 내가 그 지체에 대해 잠잠하지 않겠고, \q 그 힘센 일과 그 생김새의 아름다움에 대해서도 [잠잠하지 않겠다].
ko.B: 내가 그 몸에 대해, \q 그 강한 힘과 균형 잡힌 생김새에 대해 말하지 않을 수 없다.
ko.R: 내가 그 몸에 대해 말해 주겠다. \q 그 큰 힘과 얼마나 잘 만들어졌는지에 대해서.

decisions.choice: written "not", read "concerning it"
alternatives: I will not keep silent (as written)
concerning it I will keep silent no longer (as read)
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell "not"; the scribes' reading note gives the same sounds as "to it" or "concerning it", which the word data here follows. Either way the line announces that God will now speak about Leviathan's body, which the following verses do. The sense "I will not keep silent" is given at every level.

decisions.choice: its limbs: the parts of its body
decisions.reason: The word means limbs or parts of the body (18:13). God turns from what no one can do to Leviathan (40:25-41:3) to a description of its body, from its hide and jaws to its underside (41:5-22).

decisions.choice: the grace of its frame: the beauty and fitness of the way it is built
decisions.reason: The word for "frame" means an arrangement or order, and the word before it, a rare form, is taken to mean grace or beauty. Some read the letters as "there is none like its frame". God admires the creature he made.

decisions.choice: I will tell you about (R)
alternatives: I will not keep silent about
decisions.reason: Readable says positively what the double negative means: God will now speak about the creature.

source.text: מִֽי־גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has uncovered [the] face of garment its? Into [the] double of bridle its who will come?

en.L: Who has stripped off the face of its garment? \q Into its double bridle who can come?
en.B: Who can strip off its outer coat? \q Who can come at it with a double bridle?
en.R: Who can strip off its tough hide? \q Who can get close enough to put a bridle on it?

es.L: ¿Quién ha descubierto la faz de su vestidura? \q ¿En su doble freno quién entrará?
es.B: ¿Quién puede quitarle la capa exterior? \q ¿Quién se le acercará con doble brida?
es.R: ¿Quién puede arrancarle su piel dura? \q ¿Quién puede acercarse lo bastante para ponerle una brida?

fr.L: Qui a découvert la face de son vêtement ? \q Dans sa double bride, qui entrera ?
fr.B: Qui peut lui ôter son manteau extérieur ? \q Qui l’approchera avec une double bride ?
fr.R: Qui peut lui arracher sa peau si dure ? \q Qui peut s’approcher assez pour lui mettre une bride ?

sw.L: Ni nani aliyefunua uso wa vazi lake? \q Ni nani atakayeingia katika lijamu lake maradufu?
sw.B: Ni nani awezaye kumvua vazi lake la nje? \q Ni nani awezaye kumjia na lijamu maradufu?
sw.R: Ni nani awezaye kumchuna ngozi yake ngumu? \q Ni nani awezaye kumkaribia na kumtia lijamu?

vi.L: Ai đã lột được mặt ngoài áo nó? \q Ai sẽ vào được trong hàm thiếc đôi của nó?
vi.B: Ai có thể lột lớp áo ngoài của nó? \q Ai dám đến gần nó với dây cương đôi?
vi.R: Ai có thể lột lớp da cứng của nó? \q Ai có thể đến gần để tròng dây cương vào nó?

ko.L: 누가 그 옷의 겉면을 벗겼느냐? \q 누가 그 겹 굴레 속으로 들어가겠느냐?
ko.B: 누가 그 겉옷을 벗길 수 있느냐? \q 누가 겹 굴레를 들고 그것에게 다가갈 수 있느냐?
ko.R: 누가 그 질긴 가죽을 벗길 수 있느냐? \q 누가 가까이 가서 그것에게 굴레를 씌울 수 있느냐?

decisions.choice: the face of its garment: its outer covering, the hide and scales
decisions.reason: The "garment" is Leviathan's skin with its armor of scales (41:7-9); its "face" is the outside. No hunter can skin it.

decisions.choice: its double bridle: a bridle for its huge jaws
decisions.reason: The word means a bridle or halter (30:11; Isaiah 30:28), and "double" may describe the two jaws where a bridle would go, or its double row of teeth (41:6). With one letter different the word would mean a coat of mail, giving "Who can get through its double armor?" The standard text is followed. Either way no one can tame or pierce the creature.

decisions.choice: Who can ... (B, R)
decisions.reason: The question is about what anyone could do, not about a past event; Balanced and Readable say "Who can". Readable says "tough hide" for the garment picture (m1).

source.text: דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣יו אֵימָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] doors of face its who has opened? Around teeth its [is] terror.

en.L: The doors of its face, who has opened [them]? \q All around its teeth [is] terror.
en.B: Who can pry open the doors of its face? \q Its teeth all around are a terror.
en.R: Who can force its jaws open? \q Its teeth are terrifying.

es.L: Las puertas de su rostro, ¿quién [las] ha abierto? \q Alrededor de sus dientes [hay] terror.
es.B: ¿Quién puede abrir las puertas de su rostro? \q Sus dientes, todo alrededor, son un terror.
es.R: ¿Quién puede abrirle las mandíbulas a la fuerza? \q Sus dientes dan terror.

fr.L: Les portes de sa face, qui [les] a ouvertes ? \q Tout autour de ses dents [est] la terreur.
fr.B: Qui peut forcer les portes de sa face ? \q Tout autour, ses dents sèment la terreur.
fr.R: Qui peut lui ouvrir de force la gueule ? \q Ses dents font peur.

sw.L: Milango ya uso wake, ni nani aliyeifungua? \q Kuzunguka meno yake [kuna] kitisho.
sw.B: Ni nani awezaye kuifungua milango ya uso wake? \q Meno yake pande zote ni ya kutisha.
sw.R: Ni nani awezaye kukifungua kinywa chake kwa nguvu? \q Meno yake yanatisha sana.

vi.L: Các cửa của mặt nó, ai đã mở [được]? \q Chung quanh răng nó [là] sự kinh hãi.
vi.B: Ai có thể cạy mở các cửa của mặt nó? \q Hàm răng chung quanh của nó thật đáng kinh hãi.
vi.R: Ai có thể banh hàm nó ra? \q Răng nó thật đáng sợ.

ko.L: 그 얼굴의 문들을 누가 열었느냐? \q 그 이빨 둘레에는 두려움이 [있다].
ko.B: 누가 그 얼굴의 문들을 억지로 열 수 있느냐? \q 그 이빨은 빙 둘러 공포 그 자체다.
ko.R: 누가 그 턱을 억지로 벌릴 수 있느냐? \q 그 이빨은 보기만 해도 무섭다.

decisions.choice: the doors of its face: its jaws
decisions.reason: Its jaws are pictured as the double doors of a gate. No one can open them, as no one could open Leviathan's mouth with a hook (40:25-26).

decisions.choice: around its teeth is terror: the rows of teeth strike terror
decisions.reason: The line is a statement without a verb: the teeth all round its mouth are terror itself to anyone who sees them.

decisions.choice: its jaws (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the doors.

source.text: גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Pride [are] rows of shields, shut up [with] a seal tight.

en.L: [Its] pride [is the] rows of shields, \q shut up [with] a tight seal.
en.B: Its pride is its rows of shields, \q shut together as with a tight seal.
en.R: It is proud of its scales, like rows of shields \q closed up tight as if sealed.

es.L: [Su] orgullo [son] hileras de escudos, \q cerradas [con] un sello apretado.
es.B: Su orgullo son sus hileras de escudos, \q unidas como con un sello apretado.
es.R: Está orgulloso de sus escamas, que son como hileras de escudos \q bien cerradas, como selladas.

fr.L: [Son] orgueil, [ce sont des] rangées de boucliers, \q fermées [d’]un sceau serré.
fr.B: Son orgueil, ce sont ses rangées de boucliers, \q serrées comme par un sceau étroit.
fr.R: Il est fier de ses écailles, rangées comme des boucliers \q et bien fermées, comme scellées.

sw.L: Kiburi [chake ni] safu za ngao, \q zimefungwa [kwa] muhuri imara.
sw.B: Fahari yake ni safu zake za ngao, \q zimefungamana kama kwa muhuri imara.
sw.R: Anajivunia magamba yake, yaliyo kama safu za ngao \q zilizofungwa imara kana kwamba zimetiwa muhuri.

vi.L: Niềm kiêu hãnh [của nó là] những hàng khiên, \q khép kín [bằng] một con dấu chặt.
vi.B: Niềm kiêu hãnh của nó là những hàng khiên, \q ghép khít nhau như được đóng ấn chặt.
vi.R: Nó hãnh diện về lớp vảy của nó, như những hàng khiên \q khép chặt như được niêm phong.

ko.L: [그것의] 자랑은 방패들의 줄들이다. \q 단단한 인으로 봉한 듯 닫혀 있다.
ko.B: 그것의 자랑은 줄지어 선 방패들이니, \q 단단히 봉인한 듯 맞붙어 있다.
ko.R: 그것은 비늘을 자랑한다. 비늘은 줄지어 선 방패 같고 \q 봉인한 것처럼 꼭 닫혀 있다.

decisions.choice: pride (the standard Hebrew text)
alternatives: its back (the same letters with different vowels)
decisions.reason: The standard text has "pride": the creature's pride and glory are its scales. With different vowels the same letters can be read "its back", giving "Its back is rows of shields". The standard text is followed; pride is also where the description ends (41:26).

decisions.choice: rows of shields: its scales, set in rows like the shields of soldiers
decisions.reason: The first word usually means channels or streams; here it is taken to mean rows. The shields are the scales of its hide, set side by side and too hard to pierce (41:18-21).

decisions.choice: shut up with a tight seal: fitted together so closely that nothing gets through
decisions.reason: A seal closed a jar or a document so that nothing could open it. The scales are joined as if sealed shut; verses 8-9 say the same thing again.

decisions.choice: its scales, like rows of shields (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the scales and keeps the picture of shields as a comparison (m2).

source.text: אֶחָ֣ד בְּאֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ לֹא־יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: One to one they draw near, and air not comes between them.

en.L: One to one they draw near, \q and air does not come between them.
en.B: Each one is so close to the next \q that no air can pass between them.
en.R: They fit so close together \q that not even air can get between them.

es.L: Uno a uno se juntan, \q y el aire no entra entre ellos.
es.B: Cada uno está tan pegado al otro \q que no pasa el aire entre ellos.
es.R: Encajan tan bien \q que ni el aire puede pasar entre ellos.

fr.L: L’un à l’autre ils se joignent, \q et l’air ne passe pas entre eux.
fr.B: Chacun est si près de l’autre \q que l’air ne peut passer entre eux.
fr.R: Elles s’emboîtent si bien \q que même l’air ne peut passer entre elles.

sw.L: Moja kwa moja zinakaribiana, \q wala hewa haiingii kati yake.
sw.B: Kila moja imeambatana na nyingine kiasi \q kwamba hewa haiwezi kupita kati yake.
sw.R: Yameshikamana sana \q hata hewa haiwezi kupenya kati yake.

vi.L: Cái này sát cái kia, \q và không khí không lọt vào giữa chúng.
vi.B: Chúng khít sát với nhau \q đến nỗi không khí cũng chẳng lọt qua được.
vi.R: Chúng ghép khít đến mức \q ngay cả không khí cũng không lọt vào được.

ko.L: 하나가 하나에 가까이 붙어 \q 바람도 그 사이로 들어가지 못한다.
ko.B: 하나하나가 서로 바싹 붙어 있어 \q 그 사이로 바람 한 점 지나가지 못한다.
ko.R: 비늘들이 꼭 맞붙어 있어서 \q 공기조차 그 사이로 들어가지 못한다.

decisions.choice: air: a breath of air
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) can mean wind, breath or spirit. Here it is the smallest breath of air, which cannot slip between the scales.

decisions.choice: so close ... that
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the two lines side by side; Balanced and Readable say how they are related: the scales are so close that no air passes.

source.text: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Each to brother its they are joined; they grip one another and not are separated.

en.L: Each to its brother they are joined; \q they grip one another and are not separated.
en.B: They are joined one to another; \q they cling together and cannot be pulled apart.
en.R: They are locked together; \q they hold on to each other, and nothing can separate them.

es.L: Cada uno a su hermano se une; \q se aferran entre sí y no se separan.
es.B: Están unidos unos con otros; \q se agarran entre sí y no se pueden separar.
es.R: Están trabados entre sí; \q se sostienen unos a otros, y nada los puede separar.

fr.L: Chacun à son frère ils sont joints ; \q ils se tiennent l’un l’autre et ne se séparent pas.
fr.B: Ils sont soudés l’un à l’autre ; \q ils s’agrippent ensemble et on ne peut les séparer.
fr.R: Elles sont verrouillées ensemble ; \q elles se tiennent l’une l’autre, et rien ne peut les séparer.

sw.L: Kila moja kwa ndugu yake zimeungana; \q zinashikana wala hazitengani.
sw.B: Zimeungana moja na nyingine; \q zinashikamana wala haziwezi kutenganishwa.
sw.R: Yamefungamana pamoja; \q yanashikana, na hakuna kinachoweza kuyatenganisha.

vi.L: Mỗi cái dính với anh em nó; \q chúng bám chặt nhau và không rời ra.
vi.B: Chúng dính liền với nhau; \q bám chặt nhau, không thể tách rời.
vi.R: Chúng khóa chặt vào nhau; \q chúng giữ lấy nhau, chẳng gì tách rời được.

ko.L: 각각 그 형제에게 붙어 있고, \q 서로 움켜잡아 떨어지지 않는다.
ko.B: 그것들은 서로 맞붙어 있고 \q 꽉 달라붙어 떼어 낼 수 없다.
ko.R: 그것들은 단단히 맞물려 있다. \q 서로 붙들고 있어서 아무것도 떼어 놓을 수 없다.

decisions.choice: each to its brother: each one to the next
decisions.reason: "A man to his brother" is the Hebrew way of saying "one to another", used even of things (Exodus 25:20, of the cherubim's faces). The scales are meant.

decisions.choice: are not separated: cannot be pulled apart
decisions.reason: The verb form describes what never happens, and so what cannot happen: nothing pries the scales apart.

decisions.choice: one to another (B); locked together (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m1); Literal keeps it.

source.text: עֲֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָֽׁחַר׃

records.literal_gloss: Sneezings its flash forth light, and eyes its [are] like [the] eyelids of dawn.

en.L: Its sneezings flash forth light, \q and its eyes [are] like the eyelids of dawn.
en.B: Its snorting makes light flash out, \q and its eyes are like the first rays of dawn.
en.R: When it snorts, light flashes out. \q Its eyes glow like the sunrise.

es.L: Sus estornudos hacen brillar la luz, \q y sus ojos [son] como los párpados de la aurora.
es.B: Sus resoplidos hacen destellar la luz, \q y sus ojos son como los primeros rayos del alba.
es.R: Cuando resopla, salen destellos de luz. \q Sus ojos brillan como la salida del sol.

fr.L: Ses éternuements font jaillir la lumière, \q et ses yeux [sont] comme les paupières de l’aurore.
fr.B: Ses ébrouements font jaillir des éclairs de lumière, \q et ses yeux sont comme les premiers rayons de l’aube.
fr.R: Quand il souffle par les naseaux, la lumière jaillit. \q Ses yeux brillent comme le lever du soleil.

sw.L: Chafya zake humulika nuru, \q na macho yake [ni] kama kope za alfajiri.
sw.B: Mkoromo wake hutoa mwanga unaometameta, \q na macho yake ni kama miale ya kwanza ya alfajiri.
sw.R: Anapokoroma, mwanga hung'aa. \q Macho yake yanang'aa kama jua linapochomoza.

vi.L: Những cái hắt hơi của nó lóe ra ánh sáng, \q và mắt nó [như] mí mắt của rạng đông.
vi.B: Hơi nó phì ra làm lóe sáng, \q và mắt nó như những tia nắng đầu tiên của bình minh.
vi.R: Khi nó khịt mũi, ánh sáng lóe ra. \q Mắt nó rực sáng như mặt trời mọc.

ko.L: 그것의 재채기는 빛을 번쩍이고, \q 그 눈은 새벽의 눈꺼풀 같다.
ko.B: 그것이 콧김을 내뿜으면 빛이 번쩍이고 \q 그 눈은 동틀 녘의 첫 햇살 같다.
ko.R: 그것이 콧김을 뿜으면 빛이 번쩍인다. \q 그 눈은 떠오르는 해처럼 빛난다.

decisions.choice: its sneezings flash forth light: the spray it snorts out shines
decisions.reason: The word means a sneeze, the only time it is used in the Bible. When the great creature blows spray from its nostrils, the mist flashes in the light.

decisions.choice: the eyelids of dawn: the first light of morning
decisions.reason: The same phrase is in 3:9, where Job wished that the night of his birth would never "see the eyelids of dawn". The opening light of morning is pictured as an eye opening; Leviathan's eyes shine like it.

decisions.choice: snorting (B, R); the first rays of dawn (B); the sunrise (R)
decisions.reason: "Sneezing" sounds comic in English, so Balanced and Readable say "snorting". They give the meaning of "the eyelids of dawn" (m2), which Literal keeps.

source.text: מִ֭פִּיו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: From mouth its torches go; sparks of fire escape.

en.L: From its mouth go torches; \q sparks of fire leap out.
en.B: Flaming torches pour from its mouth; \q sparks of fire shoot out.
en.R: Fire comes out of its mouth like torches, \q and sparks fly out.

es.L: De su boca salen antorchas; \q chispas de fuego saltan.
es.B: De su boca brotan antorchas encendidas; \q salen disparadas chispas de fuego.
es.R: De su boca sale fuego como de antorchas, \q y saltan chispas.

fr.L: De sa gueule sortent des torches ; \q des étincelles de feu s’échappent.
fr.B: Des torches enflammées jaillissent de sa gueule ; \q des étincelles de feu en partent.
fr.R: Du feu sort de sa gueule comme des torches, \q et des étincelles s’envolent.

sw.L: Kinywani mwake hutoka mienge; \q cheche za moto huruka nje.
sw.B: Mienge ya moto humiminika kutoka kinywani mwake; \q cheche za moto hufyatuka.
sw.R: Moto hutoka kinywani mwake kama mienge, \q na cheche huruka.

vi.L: Từ miệng nó phóng ra những ngọn đuốc; \q những tia lửa bắn ra.
vi.B: Đuốc cháy rực tuôn ra từ miệng nó; \q những tia lửa vọt ra.
vi.R: Lửa từ miệng nó phun ra như những ngọn đuốc, \q và tia lửa bay tóe ra.

ko.L: 그 입에서 횃불들이 나오고, \q 불똥들이 튀어 나온다.
ko.B: 그 입에서 타오르는 횃불이 쏟아져 나오고 \q 불티가 튀어 오른다.
ko.R: 그 입에서 횃불 같은 불이 나오고 \q 불똥이 튄다.

decisions.choice: torches go from its mouth: a poetic picture of its fiery breath
decisions.reason: Verses 10-13 picture the creature as breathing light, smoke and fire. The poem uses the language of the great sea monster of the old poems (3:8; Psalm 74:14), larger and more terrible than any animal people hunt, to show what God alone can master.

decisions.choice: sparks: flying sparks
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It is related to a word for striking out sparks, and the line beside it with "fire" makes the sense clear.

decisions.choice: Fire comes out ... like torches (R)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the picture into a comparison so that it is clear that fire, not torches, comes from its mouth.

source.text: מִ֭נְּחִירָיו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: From nostrils its goes out smoke, as [from] a pot blown upon and rushes.

en.L: From its nostrils goes out smoke, \q as [from] a pot blown upon, and rushes.
en.B: Smoke pours from its nostrils \q as from a pot fanned to a boil over burning reeds.
en.R: Smoke comes out of its nose, \q like steam from a pot boiling over a fire of reeds.

es.L: De sus narices sale humo, \q como [de] una olla soplada, y juncos.
es.B: De sus narices sale humo \q como de una olla que hierve avivada sobre juncos encendidos.
es.R: Le sale humo por la nariz, \q como el vapor de una olla que hierve sobre un fuego de juncos.

fr.L: De ses naseaux sort de la fumée, \q comme [d’]un chaudron attisé, et des joncs.
fr.B: Une fumée sort de ses naseaux \q comme d’un chaudron qu’on attise jusqu’à l’ébullition sur des joncs en feu.
fr.R: De la fumée sort de son nez, \q comme la vapeur d’une marmite qui bout sur un feu de joncs.

sw.L: Puani mwake hutoka moshi, \q kama [kutoka] chungu kilichopulizwa, na manyasi.
sw.B: Moshi hutoka puani mwake \q kama kutoka chungu kinachochemka juu ya moto wa manyasi unaopulizwa.
sw.R: Moshi hutoka puani mwake, \q kama mvuke wa chungu kinachochemka juu ya moto wa manyasi.

vi.L: Từ lỗ mũi nó khói bốc ra, \q như [từ] cái nồi được thổi lửa, và cói.
vi.B: Khói tuôn ra từ lỗ mũi nó \q như từ nồi nước sôi trên ngọn lửa cói được thổi bùng.
vi.R: Khói bốc ra từ mũi nó, \q như hơi nước từ nồi sôi trên bếp lửa đun bằng cói.

ko.L: 그 콧구멍에서 연기가 나오니, \q 부채질한 솥과 골풀[에서 나오는 것] 같다.
ko.B: 그 콧구멍에서 연기가 쏟아져 나오니, \q 타는 골풀 위에서 부채질하여 끓이는 솥과 같다.
ko.R: 그 코에서 연기가 나온다. \q 골풀로 불을 때서 끓는 솥에서 김이 나는 것 같다.

decisions.choice: a pot blown upon: a pot over a fire that is fanned until it boils
decisions.reason: The word means a cooking pot or basket (1 Samuel 2:14; Jeremiah 24:2). "Blown upon" describes the fire under it, fanned to make it burn hot (compare Jeremiah 1:13, "a boiling pot", the same word for "blown").

decisions.choice: rushes: reeds burning as fuel under the pot
decisions.reason: The word means a bulrush or reed (40:26, where a cord made of rushes is meant). How it joins the line is not clear: most likely the reeds are the fuel, burning with smoke under the pot. Some take it as a separate picture of a smoking reed.

decisions.choice: fanned to a boil over burning reeds (B); boiling over a fire of reeds (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how the pot and the rushes belong together (m1, m2).

source.text: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Breath its coals sets ablaze, and a flame from mouth its goes out.

en.L: Its breath sets coals ablaze, \q and a flame goes out from its mouth.
en.B: Its breath sets coals on fire, \q and flames dart from its mouth.
en.R: Its breath can set coals on fire, \q and flames shoot out of its mouth.

es.L: Su aliento enciende carbones, \q y una llama sale de su boca.
es.B: Su aliento prende fuego a los carbones, \q y de su boca salen llamaradas.
es.R: Su aliento puede encender carbones, \q y le salen llamas por la boca.

fr.L: Son souffle embrase des charbons, \q et une flamme sort de sa gueule.
fr.B: Son haleine allume les charbons, \q et des flammes jaillissent de sa gueule.
fr.R: Son souffle peut allumer des braises, \q et des flammes sortent de sa gueule.

sw.L: Pumzi yake huwasha makaa, \q na mwali hutoka kinywani mwake.
sw.B: Pumzi yake huyawasha makaa moto, \q na miali hutoka kinywani mwake.
sw.R: Pumzi yake inaweza kuwasha makaa, \q na miali ya moto hutoka kinywani mwake.

vi.L: Hơi thở nó làm than cháy rực, \q và ngọn lửa ra từ miệng nó.
vi.B: Hơi thở nó làm than bốc cháy, \q và lửa phụt ra từ miệng nó.
vi.R: Hơi thở nó có thể làm than cháy đỏ, \q và lửa phun ra từ miệng nó.

ko.L: 그 숨은 숯불을 타오르게 하고, \q 그 입에서는 불꽃이 나온다.
ko.B: 그 숨결이 숯에 불을 붙이고 \q 그 입에서 불길이 뿜어 나온다.
ko.R: 그 숨으로 숯에 불을 붙일 수 있고 \q 입에서는 불길이 솟아 나온다.

decisions.choice: its breath
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) often means life or self, but its first meaning is throat or breath, which fits here beside "mouth".

decisions.choice: smoke and fire from mouth and nostrils
decisions.reason: Psalm 18:9 uses the same pictures of God coming in anger: smoke went up from his nostrils, fire from his mouth, coals blazed. The terror that people feel before Leviathan is a small likeness of the terror of God (41:2).

source.text: בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In neck its lodges strength, and before it dances dismay.

en.L: In its neck lodges strength, \q and before it dismay dances.
en.B: Strength makes its home in its neck, \q and terror dances before it.
en.R: Its neck is full of strength, \q and fear runs ahead of it wherever it goes.

es.L: En su cuello pernocta la fuerza, \q y delante de él danza el desaliento.
es.B: La fuerza tiene su morada en su cuello, \q y el terror danza delante de él.
es.R: Su cuello está lleno de fuerza, \q y por dondequiera que va, el miedo corre delante de él.

fr.L: Dans son cou loge la force, \q et devant lui danse l’effroi.
fr.B: La force a fait sa demeure dans son cou, \q et la terreur danse devant lui.
fr.R: Son cou est plein de force, \q et partout où il va, la peur court devant lui.

sw.L: Shingoni mwake hukaa nguvu, \q na mbele yake hucheza hofu.
sw.B: Nguvu imefanya makao shingoni mwake, \q na kitisho hucheza mbele yake.
sw.R: Shingo yake imejaa nguvu, \q na popote aendapo, hofu humtangulia.

vi.L: Nơi cổ nó sức mạnh trú ngụ, \q và trước mặt nó nỗi kinh hoàng nhảy múa.
vi.B: Sức mạnh cư ngụ nơi cổ nó, \q và sự kinh hãi nhảy múa trước mặt nó.
vi.R: Cổ nó đầy sức mạnh, \q và đi đến đâu thì nỗi sợ hãi chạy trước nó đến đó.

ko.L: 그 목에는 힘이 머물고, \q 그 앞에서는 낙담이 춤춘다.
ko.B: 그 목에는 힘이 깃들어 있고 \q 그 앞에서는 공포가 춤을 춘다.
ko.R: 그 목은 힘으로 가득하고 \q 그것이 가는 곳마다 두려움이 앞서 달려간다.

decisions.choice: strength lodges in its neck: its neck is where its power lives
decisions.reason: The verb means to spend the night or to stay. Strength is pictured as a guest who has made its home in the creature's neck and never leaves.

decisions.choice: dismay dances before it: terror goes ahead of it
decisions.reason: The noun, used only here, means dismay or faintness of heart. It is pictured as a person leaping along in front of the creature: wherever it comes, terror arrives first.

decisions.choice: fear runs ahead of it wherever it goes (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the picture (m2) in plain words.

source.text: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] folds of flesh its cling together; [it is] cast on it, not it is moved.

en.L: The folds of its flesh cling together; \q [they are] cast firm on it, it is not moved.
en.B: The folds of its flesh are tightly joined; \q they are set firm on it and do not move.
en.R: The folds of its skin are joined tightly. \q They are as hard as metal and cannot be moved.

es.L: Los pliegues de su carne están pegados; \q [están] fundidos sobre él, no se mueven.
es.B: Los pliegues de su carne están bien unidos; \q están firmes sobre él y no se mueven.
es.R: Los pliegues de su piel están unidos con fuerza. \q Son duros como el metal y no se pueden mover.

fr.L: Les replis de sa chair adhèrent ensemble ; \q [ils sont] coulés sur lui, il ne bouge pas.
fr.B: Les replis de sa chair sont étroitement soudés ; \q ils sont fermes sur lui et ne bougent pas.
fr.R: Les plis de sa peau sont serrés les uns contre les autres. \q Ils sont durs comme du métal et ne bougent pas.

sw.L: Makunjo ya nyama yake yameshikamana; \q yamesubiwa imara juu yake, hayatikisiki.
sw.B: Makunjo ya nyama yake yameungana kwa nguvu; \q yamekazwa juu yake wala hayatikisiki.
sw.R: Makunjo ya ngozi yake yameunganika kwa nguvu. \q Ni magumu kama chuma, wala hayawezi kutikiswa.

vi.L: Các nếp thịt của nó dính chặt nhau; \q [chúng] như đúc liền trên nó, không lay động.
vi.B: Các nếp thịt của nó gắn khít với nhau; \q chúng bám chắc trên nó và không xê dịch.
vi.R: Các nếp da của nó dính chặt vào nhau. \q Chúng cứng như kim loại, không thể lay chuyển.

ko.L: 그 살의 주름들이 서로 붙어 있고, \q 그 위에 부어 만든 듯 [굳어] 움직이지 않는다.
ko.B: 그 살의 주름들은 단단히 붙어 있고 \q 굳게 자리 잡아 움직이지 않는다.
ko.R: 그 가죽의 주름들은 꽉 붙어 있다. \q 쇠처럼 단단해서 움직일 수 없다.

decisions.choice: the folds of its flesh: the loose-hanging parts of its body
decisions.reason: The first word comes from a verb meaning to fall or hang down; here it is the flesh that would hang loose on other animals, under the belly and neck. On Leviathan even these are firm.

decisions.choice: cast: firm as metal poured in a mold
decisions.reason: The word means poured out, and so cast, like metal set hard in a mold (37:18, of the sky "hard as a cast mirror"; 38:38). It is used three times in verses 15-16 to stress how hard the creature is.

decisions.choice: as hard as metal (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of cast metal (m2).

source.text: לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ־אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק כְּפֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: Heart its [is] cast like a stone, and cast like a millstone lower.

en.L: Its heart [is] cast like a stone, \q and cast like a lower millstone.
en.B: Its heart is as hard as rock, \q as hard as a lower millstone.
en.R: Its heart is as hard as rock, \q as hard as the bottom stone of a mill.

es.L: Su corazón [está] fundido como piedra, \q fundido como la piedra de molino de abajo.
es.B: Su corazón es duro como la roca, \q duro como la muela de abajo.
es.R: Su corazón es duro como la roca, \q tan duro como la piedra de abajo de un molino.

fr.L: Son cœur [est] coulé comme une pierre, \q coulé comme la meule de dessous.
fr.B: Son cœur est dur comme le roc, \q dur comme la meule de dessous.
fr.R: Son cœur est dur comme la pierre, \q aussi dur que la pierre du bas d’un moulin.

sw.L: Moyo wake umesubiwa kama jiwe, \q umesubiwa kama jiwe la chini la kusagia.
sw.B: Moyo wake ni mgumu kama mwamba, \q mgumu kama jiwe la chini la kusagia.
sw.R: Moyo wake ni mgumu kama mwamba, \q mgumu kama lile jiwe la chini ambalo nafaka husagiwa juu yake.

vi.L: Tim nó đúc cứng như đá, \q đúc cứng như thớt cối dưới.
vi.B: Tim nó cứng như đá, \q cứng như thớt dưới của cối xay.
vi.R: Tim nó cứng như đá tảng, \q cứng như hòn đá nằm dưới của cối xay.

ko.L: 그 심장은 돌처럼 굳게 부어졌고, \q 아랫맷돌처럼 굳게 부어졌다.
ko.B: 그 가슴은 바위처럼 단단하고 \q 아랫맷돌처럼 단단하다.
ko.R: 그 가슴은 바위처럼 단단하다. \q 맷돌의 아래짝처럼 단단하다.

decisions.choice: its heart: its chest, and with it its courage
decisions.reason: The heart can mean the inner body or the inner person. Here both are meant: its chest is hard as stone, and nothing can frighten it (41:25).

decisions.choice: a lower millstone: the bottom stone of a hand mill
decisions.reason: Grain was ground between two stones. The lower one bore all the weight and pounding of the upper stone, so it had to be the hardest.

decisions.choice: the bottom stone of a mill (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a lower millstone is (m2).

source.text: מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: From rising up its are afraid [the] mighty; from crashings they are bewildered.

en.L: At its rising up the mighty are afraid; \q at the crashing they are beside themselves.
en.B: When it raises itself up, the mighty are afraid; \q at its crashing they are thrown into confusion.
en.R: When it rises up, even the strongest are afraid. \q When it crashes about, they do not know where to turn.

es.L: Ante su alzarse temen los poderosos; \q ante el estruendo quedan fuera de sí.
es.B: Cuando se levanta, los poderosos tienen miedo; \q ante su estrépito quedan aturdidos.
es.R: Cuando se levanta, hasta los más fuertes tienen miedo. \q Cuando se agita, no saben adónde ir.

fr.L: À son lever, les puissants ont peur ; \q aux fracas, ils sont désemparés.
fr.B: Quand il se dresse, les puissants ont peur ; \q à son fracas, ils perdent la tête.
fr.R: Quand il se lève, même les plus forts ont peur. \q Quand il s’agite avec fracas, ils ne savent plus où aller.

sw.L: Anapoinuka wenye nguvu huogopa; \q kwa mivumo [yake] hufadhaika.
sw.B: Anapojiinua, mashujaa huogopa; \q kwa mshindo wake huchanganyikiwa.
sw.R: Anapoinuka, hata wenye nguvu kuliko wote huogopa. \q Anaporusharusha, hawajui waende wapi.

vi.L: Khi nó trỗi dậy, các dũng sĩ đều sợ; \q bởi tiếng đổ ầm, họ mất cả hồn vía.
vi.B: Khi nó đứng lên, các dũng sĩ đều khiếp sợ; \q tiếng nó vùng vẫy làm họ rối loạn.
vi.R: Khi nó nổi lên, ngay cả người mạnh nhất cũng sợ. \q Khi nó quẫy mạnh, họ không biết chạy đi đâu.

ko.L: 그것이 일어나면 용사들이 두려워하고, \q 그 부서지는 소리에 넋을 잃는다.
ko.B: 그것이 몸을 일으키면 용사들도 두려워하고 \q 그것이 요동치는 소리에 갈팡질팡한다.
ko.R: 그것이 일어서면 가장 힘센 사람들도 겁을 낸다. \q 그것이 몸부림치면 어디로 가야 할지 모른다.

decisions.choice: the mighty: the strongest of men
decisions.reason: The word can mean mighty men (Exodus 15:15; Ezekiel 17:13) or gods (Exodus 15:11). If "gods" is meant, the verse says that even divine beings fear Leviathan, as in the old poems. The first sense is followed; either way no one stands before it.

decisions.choice: crashings: the crash of its thrashing, or of the waves it raises
decisions.reason: The word means breaking or crashing, and is used of breakers in the sea (Psalm 42:8 has a related word). It is the crash when the creature thrashes and the water breaks around it.

decisions.choice: they are beside themselves: they lose their way in panic
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the root meaning to miss the mark. Here it means that people are thrown off course and do not know what to do.

decisions.choice: they do not know where to turn (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the verb (m3) in plain words.

source.text: מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] reaching it [with] a sword not it holds, spear, dart, and javelin.

en.L: [If one] reaches it [with] a sword, it does not hold, \q [nor] spear, dart, or javelin.
en.B: A sword that reaches it has no effect, \q nor does a spear, a dart, or a javelin.
en.R: A sword cannot hurt it, \q and neither can a spear, a dart, or a javelin.

es.L: [Si alguien] lo alcanza [con] espada, no resiste, \q [ni] lanza, dardo o jabalina.
es.B: La espada que lo alcanza no le hace nada, \q ni la lanza, ni el dardo, ni la jabalina.
es.R: Una espada no le puede hacer daño, \q y tampoco una lanza, un dardo o una jabalina.

fr.L: [Si on] l’atteint [de] l’épée, elle ne tient pas, \q [ni] lance, ni dard, ni javelot.
fr.B: L’épée qui l’atteint reste sans effet, \q de même la lance, le dard ou le javelot.
fr.R: Une épée ne peut pas le blesser, \q ni une lance, ni un dard, ni un javelot.

sw.L: [Mtu] akimfikia [kwa] upanga, hausimami, \q [wala] mkuki, kishale, wala mkuki wa kurusha.
sw.B: Upanga unaomfikia haufui dafu, \q wala mkuki, kishale au sagai.
sw.R: Upanga hauwezi kumdhuru, \q wala mkuki, kishale au mkuki wa kurusha.

vi.L: [Ai] đến gần nó [với] gươm, [gươm] chẳng đứng vững, \q [cả] giáo, lao, hay mác [cũng vậy].
vi.B: Gươm chạm đến nó cũng chẳng làm gì được, \q giáo, lao hay mác cũng vậy.
vi.R: Gươm không làm nó bị thương được, \q giáo, lao hay mác cũng không.

ko.L: 칼이 그것에 닿아도 버티지 못하고, \q 창과 투창과 작살도 [그러하다].
ko.B: 칼로 그것을 쳐도 소용이 없고 \q 창이나 표창이나 투창도 마찬가지다.
ko.R: 칼로도 그것을 해칠 수 없다. \q 창이나 표창이나 투창도 소용없다.

decisions.choice: a sword that reaches it does not hold
decisions.reason: The line begins with "one reaching it". Even when a sword gets close enough to strike, it does not stand up against the creature; it has no effect (compare 41:19-21).

decisions.choice: dart, javelin: kinds of thrown weapons
alternatives: coat of mail (for the last word)
decisions.reason: Both words are rare, and the exact weapons are not known. Some link the last word to the word for a coat of mail, but in a list of weapons it is most likely a kind of javelin.

decisions.choice: has no effect (B); cannot hurt it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what it means for the sword not to "hold" (m1).

source.text: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְתֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְעֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: It considers as straw iron, as wood of rottenness bronze.

en.L: It regards iron as straw, \q bronze as rotten wood.
en.B: It treats iron like straw \q and bronze like rotten wood.
en.R: To it, iron is like straw, \q and bronze is like rotten wood.

es.L: Tiene el hierro por paja, \q el bronce por madera podrida.
es.B: Trata el hierro como paja \q y el bronce como madera podrida.
es.R: Para él, el hierro es como paja, \q y el bronce como madera podrida.

fr.L: Il tient le fer pour de la paille, \q le bronze pour du bois pourri.
fr.B: Il traite le fer comme de la paille \q et le bronze comme du bois pourri.
fr.R: Pour lui, le fer est comme de la paille, \q et le bronze comme du bois pourri.

sw.L: Huhesabu chuma kama nyasi kavu, \q shaba kama mti uliooza.
sw.B: Huchukulia chuma kama majani makavu \q na shaba kama mti uliooza.
sw.R: Kwake chuma ni kama majani makavu, \q na shaba ni kama mti uliooza.

vi.L: Nó coi sắt như rơm, \q đồng như gỗ mục.
vi.B: Nó xem sắt như rơm rạ \q và đồng như gỗ mục.
vi.R: Với nó, sắt chỉ như rơm, \q còn đồng như gỗ mục.

ko.L: 그것은 쇠를 지푸라기로 여기고, \q 놋을 썩은 나무로 여긴다.
ko.B: 그것은 쇠를 지푸라기처럼, \q 놋쇠를 썩은 나무처럼 여긴다.
ko.R: 그것에게는 쇠도 지푸라기 같고 \q 놋쇠도 썩은 나무 같다.

decisions.choice: iron and bronze: the metals of weapons and armor
decisions.reason: Iron and bronze were the hardest materials known for weapons and armor (20:24, "the iron weapon" and "the bronze bow"). Leviathan treats the strongest things people can make as weak and worthless.

source.text: לֹֽא־יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן־קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־ל֥וֹ אַבְנֵי־קָֽלַע׃

records.literal_gloss: Not makes flee it [the] son of a bow; into chaff are turned for it [the] stones of a sling.

en.L: The son of a bow does not make it flee; \q sling stones are turned into chaff for it.
en.B: Arrows do not make it run away; \q sling stones are like chaff to it.
en.R: Arrows cannot make it run away. \q Stones from a sling are like bits of straw to it.

es.L: El hijo del arco no lo hace huir; \q las piedras de la honda se le vuelven paja.
es.B: Las flechas no lo hacen huir; \q las piedras de la honda son para él como paja.
es.R: Las flechas no lo pueden hacer huir. \q Las piedras de una honda son para él como pajitas.

fr.L: Le fils de l’arc ne le fait pas fuir ; \q les pierres de la fronde se changent pour lui en balle.
fr.B: Les flèches ne le font pas fuir ; \q les pierres de fronde sont pour lui comme de la balle.
fr.R: Les flèches ne peuvent pas le faire fuir. \q Les pierres lancées par une fronde sont pour lui comme des brins de paille.

sw.L: Mwana wa upinde hamkimbizi; \q mawe ya kombeo hugeuka makapi kwake.
sw.B: Mishale haimkimbizi; \q mawe ya kombeo ni kama makapi kwake.
sw.R: Mishale haiwezi kumfanya akimbie. \q Mawe ya kombeo ni kama vipande vya majani kwake.

vi.L: Con của cây cung không khiến nó chạy trốn; \q đá ném bằng trành hóa thành rơm rác đối với nó.
vi.B: Tên bắn chẳng làm nó bỏ chạy; \q đá ném bằng trành chỉ như rơm rác đối với nó.
vi.R: Tên bắn không làm nó chạy trốn được. \q Đá ném bằng trành chỉ như cọng rơm đối với nó.

ko.L: 활의 아들도 그것을 도망치게 하지 못하고, \q 물맷돌도 그것에게는 겨가 된다.
ko.B: 화살도 그것을 쫓아내지 못하고 \q 물맷돌도 그것에게는 겨와 같다.
ko.R: 화살로도 그것을 쫓아 버릴 수 없다. \q 물맷돌도 그것에게는 지푸라기 같다.

decisions.choice: the son of a bow: an arrow
decisions.reason: Hebrew often calls something the "son" of what it comes from; an arrow is the "son" of the bow (compare Lamentations 3:13, "the sons of his quiver").

decisions.choice: chaff: dry stubble or straw that is worthless and light
decisions.reason: The word means dry stubble or chaff, which the wind blows away (13:25; Psalm 83:14). The stones do it no more harm than chaff would.

decisions.choice: arrows (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m1).

source.text: כְּ֭קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Like chaff are regarded clubs; and it laughs at [the] rattling of a javelin.

en.L: Like chaff a club is regarded, \q and it laughs at the rattling of a javelin.
en.B: A club seems like chaff to it, \q and it laughs at the rattle of a javelin.
en.R: Clubs are like straw to it. \q It laughs when a spear comes rattling toward it.

es.L: Como paja es tenida la maza, \q y se ríe del vibrar de la jabalina.
es.B: La maza le parece paja, \q y se ríe del zumbido de la jabalina.
es.R: Los garrotes son como paja para él. \q Se ríe cuando una lanza viene zumbando hacia él.

fr.L: Comme de la balle est comptée la massue, \q et il rit du sifflement du javelot.
fr.B: La massue lui semble de la balle, \q et il se rit du cliquetis du javelot.
fr.R: Les massues sont comme de la paille pour lui. \q Il rit quand une lance arrive sur lui en sifflant.

sw.L: Kama makapi rungu huhesabiwa, \q naye hucheka mtikiso wa mkuki.
sw.B: Rungu ni kama makapi kwake, \q naye huucheka mvumo wa mkuki.
sw.R: Marungu ni kama majani kwake. \q Huchekelea mkuki unapovuma kuelekea kwake.

vi.L: Như rơm rác chùy được coi, \q và nó cười nhạo tiếng lao rít.
vi.B: Chùy đối với nó như rơm rác, \q và nó cười nhạo tiếng lao vun vút.
vi.R: Chùy chỉ như rơm đối với nó. \q Nó cười khi ngọn giáo lao vun vút đến.

ko.L: 몽둥이도 겨처럼 여겨지고, \q 그것은 투창이 흔들리는 소리를 비웃는다.
ko.B: 몽둥이도 그것에게는 겨 같고 \q 그것은 휙휙 날아오는 투창 소리를 비웃는다.
ko.R: 몽둥이도 그것에게는 지푸라기 같다. \q 창이 휙 날아와도 그것은 웃어 버린다.

decisions.choice: a club: a heavy war club
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here; most likely it is a heavy club or mace. The verb with it is plural, so it may mean clubs of every kind.

decisions.choice: the rattling of a javelin: the whirr and shaking of a javelin thrown at it
decisions.reason: The javelin is the weapon that rattles against the warhorse in 39:23. The noise of battle does not trouble Leviathan.

decisions.choice: it laughs: it scorns what would frighten others
decisions.reason: The wild donkey laughs at the noise of the city (39:7), the ostrich at the horse and rider (39:18), and the warhorse at fear (39:22). Leviathan laughs at the weapons of war.

source.text: תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי־טִֽיט׃

records.literal_gloss: Under it [are] sharp points of potsherd; it spreads out a threshing sledge on [the] mud.

en.L: Under it [are] sharp points of potsherd; \q it spreads out a threshing sledge on the mud.
en.B: Its underside is like jagged pieces of pottery; \q it leaves a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
en.R: Its belly is as sharp as broken pottery. \q It leaves marks in the mud like a threshing sledge.

es.L: Debajo de él [hay] puntas afiladas de tiesto; \q extiende un trillo sobre el lodo.
es.B: Su vientre es como pedazos filosos de vasija; \q deja un rastro en el barro como un trillo.
es.R: Su vientre es tan cortante como cerámica rota. \q Deja marcas en el barro como un trillo.

fr.L: Sous lui [sont] des pointes aiguës de tesson ; \q il étend un traîneau à battre sur la boue.
fr.B: Son ventre est comme des tessons tranchants ; \q il laisse dans la boue une trace pareille à celle d’un traîneau à battre.
fr.R: Son ventre est coupant comme de la poterie cassée. \q Il laisse dans la boue des marques comme un traîneau à battre le grain.

sw.L: Chini yake [kuna] ncha kali za vigae; \q hutandaza chombo cha kupuria juu ya matope.
sw.B: Tumbo lake ni kama vipande vikali vya vyungu; \q huacha alama matopeni kama chombo cha kupuria.
sw.R: Tumbo lake lina ncha kali kama vigae vya vyungu. \q Huacha mikwaruzo matopeni kama chombo cha kupuria nafaka.

vi.L: Dưới nó [là] những mũi nhọn của mảnh gốm; \q nó trải một bàn đập lúa trên bùn.
vi.B: Bụng nó như những mảnh gốm vỡ lởm chởm; \q nó để lại vết trên bùn như bàn đập lúa.
vi.R: Bụng nó sắc như mảnh gốm vỡ. \q Nó để lại dấu trên bùn như bàn đập lúa.

ko.L: 그 아래에는 날카로운 질그릇 조각들이 [있고], \q 그것은 진흙 위에 타작 썰매를 펼친다.
ko.B: 그 배 밑은 날카로운 질그릇 조각 같고 \q 진흙 위에 타작 썰매 같은 자국을 남긴다.
ko.R: 그 배는 깨진 질그릇처럼 날카롭다. \q 진흙에 타작 썰매 같은 자국을 남긴다.

decisions.choice: sharp points of potsherd: its underside is as rough and sharp as broken pottery
decisions.reason: A potsherd is a piece of broken pottery, with sharp edges (2:8, where Job scraped himself with one). The scales under its belly are like them.

decisions.choice: a threshing sledge: a heavy board with sharp stones or iron set underneath
decisions.reason: Grain was threshed by dragging a heavy wooden sledge over it; sharp stones or iron teeth under the board cut the stalks (Isaiah 41:15; Amos 1:3). Where Leviathan crawls through the mud, it leaves marks like such a sledge.

decisions.choice: it leaves a trail (B) / marks (R) in the mud like a threshing sledge
alternatives: it spreads out a threshing sledge
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the picture into a comparison and say what it leaves behind.

source.text: יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: It makes boil like the pot [the] deep; [the] sea it makes like the pot of ointment.

en.L: It makes the deep boil like a pot; \q it makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
en.B: It makes the depths churn like a boiling pot; \q it stirs up the sea like a pot of perfumed oil.
en.R: It makes the deep water boil like a pot. \q It stirs up the sea like oil being mixed in a pot.

es.L: Hace hervir como una olla lo profundo; \q hace el mar como una olla de ungüento.
es.B: Hace bullir las profundidades como una olla hirviendo; \q agita el mar como una olla de aceite perfumado.
es.R: Hace hervir las aguas profundas como una olla. \q Agita el mar como aceite que se mezcla en una olla.

fr.L: Il fait bouillir l’abîme comme une marmite ; \q il rend la mer pareille à un pot d’onguent.
fr.B: Il fait bouillonner les profondeurs comme une marmite ; \q il agite la mer comme un vase d’huile parfumée.
fr.R: Il fait bouillir l’eau profonde comme une marmite. \q Il remue la mer comme de l’huile qu’on mélange dans un pot.

sw.L: Huchemsha vilindi kama sufuria; \q huifanya bahari kama chungu cha marashi.
sw.B: Huvitibua vilindi kama chungu kinachochemka; \q huichafua bahari kama chungu cha mafuta yenye manukato.
sw.R: Hufanya maji ya kilindini yachemke kama sufuria. \q Huichafua bahari kama mafuta yanayokorogwa chunguni.

vi.L: Nó làm vực sâu sôi lên như nồi; \q nó làm biển như nồi dầu thơm.
vi.B: Nó khuấy vực sâu sôi sục như nồi nước sôi; \q nó làm biển nổi bọt như nồi dầu thơm.
vi.R: Nó làm nước sâu sôi lên như một cái nồi. \q Nó khuấy biển lên như dầu đang trộn trong nồi.

ko.L: 그것은 깊은 물을 솥처럼 끓게 하고, \q 바다를 향유 솥처럼 만든다.
ko.B: 그것은 깊은 바다를 끓는 솥처럼 들끓게 하고 \q 바다를 향기름 솥처럼 휘젓는다.
ko.R: 그것은 깊은 물을 솥처럼 끓게 한다. \q 솥에서 기름을 섞듯이 바다를 휘젓는다.

decisions.choice: a pot of ointment: a pot where perfumed oil is mixed and heated
decisions.reason: Perfumed oil was made by heating oil with spices and stirring it (Exodus 30:25). The foaming sea is like the bubbling oil in such a pot.

decisions.choice: the deep, the sea: the waters where Leviathan lives
decisions.reason: The first word means the depths of the sea (Jonah 2:4; Psalm 107:24). Leviathan is the creature of the sea, which God made it to play in (Psalm 104:26).

source.text: אַ֭חֲרָיו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Behind it it makes shine a path; one considers [the] deep to [be] gray hair.

en.L: Behind it it makes a path shine; \q one would think the deep [had] gray hair.
en.B: It leaves a shining wake behind it; \q one would think the deep had white hair.
en.R: It leaves a bright trail behind it in the water. \q You would think the deep sea had white hair.

es.L: Detrás de él hace brillar un sendero; \q uno pensaría que el abismo [tiene] canas.
es.B: Deja tras de sí una estela brillante; \q uno pensaría que el abismo tiene el cabello blanco.
es.R: Deja en el agua un rastro brillante. \q Parecería que el mar profundo tiene el pelo blanco.

fr.L: Derrière lui il fait briller un sentier ; \q on croirait que l’abîme [a] des cheveux gris.
fr.B: Il laisse derrière lui un sillage lumineux ; \q on dirait que l’abîme a les cheveux blancs.
fr.R: Il laisse derrière lui une traînée brillante dans l’eau. \q On croirait que la mer profonde a les cheveux blancs.

sw.L: Nyuma yake huifanya njia ing'ae; \q mtu angedhani kilindi [kina] mvi.
sw.B: Huacha nyuma yake mkondo unaong'aa; \q mtu angedhani kilindi kina nywele nyeupe.
sw.R: Huacha nyuma yake njia inayong'aa majini. \q Ungedhani bahari kuu ina nywele nyeupe.

vi.L: Phía sau nó, nó làm một lối đi sáng loáng; \q người ta tưởng vực sâu [có] tóc bạc.
vi.B: Nó để lại phía sau một vệt nước sáng ngời; \q người ta tưởng vực sâu đã bạc đầu.
vi.R: Nó để lại một vệt sáng trên mặt nước phía sau. \q Ngươi sẽ tưởng biển sâu có mái tóc bạc trắng.

ko.L: 그것은 자기 뒤에 길을 빛나게 하니, \q 사람들은 깊은 물이 백발[이 되었다]고 여긴다.
ko.B: 그것이 지나간 뒤에는 빛나는 물길이 남아 \q 깊은 바다가 백발이 된 줄로 여길 정도다.
ko.R: 그것이 지나가면 물 위에 하얀 길이 반짝인다. \q 깊은 바다가 흰 머리가 된 것 같다.

decisions.choice: the deep had gray hair: its wake is white with foam
decisions.reason: The white foam of the wake is pictured as the white hair of an old man. The "deep" (tehom) is the great ocean (38:16, 30; Genesis 1:2).

decisions.choice: white hair (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means the gray or white hair of old age (15:10). In English "white hair" better fits the white of foam.

source.text: אֵֽין־עַל־עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי־חָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: There is not on [the] dust likeness its, the [one] made for being without terror.

en.L: There is not on [the] dust its like, \q the [one] made to be without fear.
en.B: Nothing on earth is its equal, \q a creature made without fear.
en.R: There is nothing like it on earth. \q It was made to have no fear.

es.L: No hay sobre el polvo semejante a él, \q el [que fue] hecho para no tener miedo.
es.B: Nada en la tierra se le iguala, \q criatura hecha sin miedo.
es.R: No hay nada como él en la tierra. \q Fue hecho para no tener miedo.

fr.L: Il n’y a pas sur la poussière son pareil, \q celui [qui fut] fait pour être sans crainte.
fr.B: Rien sur terre ne l’égale, \q créature faite pour ne rien craindre.
fr.R: Il n’y a rien de pareil à lui sur la terre. \q Il a été fait pour ne jamais avoir peur.

sw.L: Hakuna juu ya mavumbi [aliye] kama yeye, \q aliyefanywa ili asiwe na hofu.
sw.B: Hakuna duniani anayelingana naye, \q kiumbe aliyeumbwa bila hofu.
sw.R: Hakuna kitu kama yeye duniani. \q Aliumbwa asiwe na hofu.

vi.L: Trên bụi đất không có gì giống nó, \q loài được tạo nên để không biết sợ.
vi.B: Trên đất không có gì sánh bằng nó, \q một tạo vật được dựng nên không biết sợ hãi.
vi.R: Trên đất không có gì giống như nó. \q Nó được tạo nên để không biết sợ.

ko.L: 티끌 위에는 그와 같은 것이 없으니, \q 두려움 없이 지어진 것이다.
ko.B: 땅 위에는 그것에 견줄 것이 없으니, \q 두려움 없이 지어진 피조물이다.
ko.R: 세상에는 그것과 같은 것이 없다. \q 그것은 두려움을 모르도록 지어졌다.

decisions.choice: the dust: the earth, the dry land
decisions.reason: "Dust" stands for the earth and its ground (19:25; 30:6). Nothing on the earth compares with this creature of the sea.

decisions.choice: the one made: a creature that God made
decisions.reason: However terrible it is, Leviathan was made, as Behemoth was made by God alongside Job (40:15, 19). Psalm 104:26 says God formed Leviathan to play in the sea.

decisions.choice: without fear: it knows no terror
decisions.reason: The noun means terror or dread (compare 41:17, where the mighty are afraid of it). It fears nothing, while everything else fears it.

source.text: אֵֽת־כָּל־גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־בְּנֵי־שָֽׁחַץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Every high [thing] it looks on; it [is] king over all [the] sons of pride.

en.L: Every high [thing] it looks on; \q it [is] king over all the sons of pride.
en.B: It looks down on everything that is lofty; \q it is king over all the proud beasts.
en.R: It looks down on everything that is high and mighty. \q It is king over every proud creature.

es.L: A todo lo alto mira; \q él [es] rey sobre todos los hijos de la soberbia.
es.B: Mira desde arriba todo lo que es altivo; \q es rey sobre todas las fieras orgullosas.
es.R: Mira por encima a todo lo que es alto y poderoso. \q Es el rey de todas las criaturas orgullosas.

fr.L: Tout ce qui est haut, il le regarde ; \q il [est] roi sur tous les fils de l’orgueil.
fr.B: Il regarde de haut tout ce qui est élevé ; \q il est roi de toutes les bêtes orgueilleuses.
fr.R: Il regarde de haut tout ce qui est grand et puissant. \q Il est le roi de toutes les créatures fières.

sw.L: Kila kilicho juu hukitazama; \q yeye [ni] mfalme juu ya wana wote wa kiburi.
sw.B: Hukitazama kwa dharau kila kilichotukuka; \q yeye ni mfalme juu ya wanyama wote wenye kiburi.
sw.R: Huvidharau vyote vilivyo juu na vyenye nguvu. \q Yeye ni mfalme wa viumbe vyote vyenye kiburi.

vi.L: Mọi vật cao, nó đều nhìn xuống; \q nó [là] vua trên tất cả con cái của sự kiêu ngạo.
vi.B: Nó nhìn xuống mọi vật cao ngạo; \q nó là vua của mọi loài thú kiêu hãnh.
vi.R: Nó coi thường mọi thứ cao sang và mạnh mẽ. \q Nó là vua của mọi loài kiêu ngạo.

ko.L: 그것은 모든 높은 것을 내려다보니, \q 모든 교만의 자식들 위에 왕이다.
ko.B: 그것은 높은 것들을 모두 내려다보고 \q 모든 오만한 짐승들의 왕이다.
ko.R: 그것은 높고 힘센 것들을 모두 깔본다. \q 그것은 교만한 모든 피조물의 왕이다.

decisions.choice: the sons of pride: the proud wild beasts
decisions.reason: The same phrase in 28:8 means the proud wild beasts, which have not walked the hidden paths of the mines. Leviathan is the greatest of them all.

decisions.choice: it looks on every high thing: what God asked Job to do
decisions.reason: In 40:11-12 God challenged Job to look on everyone who is proud and bring him low. Job cannot do it, but Leviathan looks down on everything high, and God is master of Leviathan. With this verse God's speeches end; Job answers in 42:1-6.

decisions.choice: the proud beasts (B); every proud creature (R)
decisions.reason: As in 28:8, Balanced and Readable say who the "sons of pride" are (m1).
